I replied to Pree in a thread under their message in #central-team: "Thanks, Pree. Noted: the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Dock 23."

They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. I didn't check any other records or change them, and I didn't save the fact to my persistent memory. It now sits in the #central-team thread, where anyone in that channel can find it.
